archetypes.name: lint-scope
archetypes.rationale: Retired-script basename detection must stay tightly scoped to dev skill markdown.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the retired-script lint change for false positives and false negatives. Focus on the .claude/skills markdown eligibility, live-sibling guard, lint-ignore behavior, and path-boundary regex Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: title-parity
archetypes.rationale: Finalize and verify-main intentionally preserve different title matching edges.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shared title matcher against the old finalize and verify-main semantics. Check numbered expected titles, suffix-only matching, raw-prefix behavior, and double-append avoidance Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
